ctx.x: He beat your sister out of that gym? He beat us.

It seems that way. So, I played with them, oh, for quite a few years. We played the various spots, the yacht club, and different bands, all the old moves clubs, and so forth and so on. And as time went on, Eddie Watson, who played the guitar later, went to saxophone. So did his brother, Harry, who used to play trumpet. He'd taken an alto sax, and so did his brother.
